task: ae.net IPv4 codec, fragmenter, reassembler and UDP checksum
reasoning_summary: Checksum, strict header codec, MTU fragmenter, a stateful reassembler (first-arrival-wins overlaps, malformed datagram discard, timeout and oldest-eviction) and UDP pseudo-header checksum. Tests were literal hex fixtures, strict-decode rejections with one-defect controls, shuffled/duplicated round trips and a per-step byte-coverage oracle. A 24-mutant pass found one real gap (a second last fragment ending later), fixed with a test.
